parts.name: Sphere
parts.Basic_description: The sphere is the main part of the globe, made of plastic, representing the Earth's surface with printed maps. It is approximately 25 cm in diameter.
parts.Functional_description: It displays geographical information such as continents, countries, and oceans. It can rotate around its axis to simulate Earth's rotation.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates smoothly around the tilted axis supported by the base body.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the supporting structure of the globe, made of plastic, with a curved arm holding the sphere and a flat bottom for stability.
parts.Functional_description: It provides support and balance to the globe, allowing the sphere to rotate freely while keeping the entire object upright.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the pivot support for the rotating sphere.
